verdict.rationale: The GitHub README states Zero "does not track, collect, or sell your data in any way," implying no telemetry exists to opt out of, and self-hosting (zero-gh-2/6/8) gives users full control over any data flows. However, there is no explicit settings/toggle documentation for telemetry opt-out, no mention of what analytics (if any) run in hosted mode, and no independent verification of the no-tracking claim. Missing for 10: explicit telemetry/analytics settings documentation, third-party or hands-on confirmation of the no-tracking claim, and details on hosted-vs-self-hosted data collection differences.
